steps.title: What is evaporation?
steps.source: Evaporation is the change of liquid water into water vapor, a gas, at the surface of the liquid.

steps.title: Can water evaporate without boiling?
steps.source: Evaporation can happen below the boiling point; water does not have to boil to evaporate.

steps.title: How does temperature affect evaporation speed?
steps.source: warmer water evaporates faster because its particles have more energy and more can escape from the surface into the air.

steps.title: What role does surface area play?
steps.source: spreading the same amount of water over a larger exposed surface makes it evaporate faster.

steps.title: How do real-world examples illustrate these ideas?
steps.source: a thin wet cloth spread out in a warm room usually dries faster than an equally wet cloth folded up in a cooler room
